concerns.text: Tasks T001a, T001b, T003, and T004 are marked [X] (completed) despite the 'Analyze Report' explicitly stating these artifacts (directories, __init__.py, linting configs) do not exist. This is a semantic weakening of the 'Reproducibility' and 'Data Hygiene' constitution principles, as the task list falsely claims the foundational infrastructure required for FR-001 and FR-002 is already in place.

Task T019 (VIF calculation and logging to model_results.json) is marked [X] but the 'Analyze Report' confirms the output artifact is missing. This violates FR-003 and SC-002, as the task deliverable (logging VIF status) is not achieved, effectively weakening the requirement to 'calculate and report VIF'.

Task T021 (Integrate regression results into main.py to save model_results.json) is marked [X] but the 'Analyze Report' confirms the aggregation logic is missing. This violates FR-002 and SC-002, as the system cannot 'output a coefficient estimate... with a 95% confidence interval' if the results are not saved.

Task T027a (Validate visualization file count against SC-005) is marked [X] but the 'Analyze Report' states the logic is missing. This violates SC-005, as the task claims to enforce the 'minimum set of files' requirement but fails to implement the verification step.

Tasks T029 (Documentation) and T030 (Code cleanup/ruff/black) are marked [X] but the 'Analyze Report' confirms README, quickstart, and linting logs are absent. This violates Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) and Principle III (Data Hygiene), as the project lacks the mandatory documentation and quality gates required for a fresh runner execution.

Task T015 (Implement processor for FR-008) is marked [X] but the 'Analyze Report' notes the pipeline implementation is incomplete. This violates FR-008, which mandates deriving 'Perceived Social Validation' from engagement and sentiment; without the processor, the measurement model is not functionally realized.
